points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Are all three Edit actions on the same end of their rows, opposite the label?
Does the email layla@example.com stay left to right and unbroken?
Does the phone number +971 50 123 4567 keep its plus sign and order?
Does the IBAN AE07 0331 2345 6789 0123 456 keep its groups in order?
Does each detail (name, email, phone, IBAN) have a label saying what it is?
Is each Edit action beside its own detail, not the row above or below?
